findings.summary: rename() loads the document via self.repo.get(doc_id) instead of self._owned(user_id, doc_id), so no ownership check happens and any user can rename another user's document.

judge.reason: Identifies rename using repo.get instead of _owned, allowing cross-user rename.

findings.label: hit

findings.summary: Skipping _owned also bypasses the NotFound raised for other users' documents, letting callers distinguish which document ids exist (information leak).

judge.reason: Same root cause (skipping _owned); describes the id-existence leak noted in the key.

findings.label: hit
